title: A fibrewise flatness criterion with openness of the locus in the support
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The theorem compares two ways of testing flatness at a point of the support: flatness over the base together with flatness of the fibre module over the fibre of the intermediate morphism, versus flatness of the intermediate morphism at the image together with flatness of the module over it. The proof establishes the equivalence by reducing to the local situation and comparing the two associated graded pieces, and then shows the locus where the conditions hold is open in the support by exhibiting it as the complement of a closed condition on a finitely presented module. The comparison of the two flatness conditions together with the openness argument is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 4612-4655.
